question: Which of the following novels is written by Kiran Desai?
solution:
Correct answer is __**The Inheritance of Loss.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The title of the novel The Inheritance or Loss is **meant to encapsulate the generational continuation of loss that these immigrants have experienced**.
 
• The story is about **the lives of Biju and Sai**.
 
• Biju is an Indian living in the** United States illegally,** son of a cook who works for Sai's grandfather.
 
• **Sai is an orphan living in mountainous Kalimpong** with her maternal grandfather, Jemubhai Patel; the cook; and a dog named Mutt.

**​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/14344d3f35b3f4d1b38fdb46b7f3e31721e44c1019a0de90728733dc8ae5c340.png] **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Ministry of Utmost Happiness** is the second novel by Indian **writer Arundhati Roy,** published in 2017.
 
• **Midnight's Children** is a 1981 novel by British-Indian **writer Salman Rushdie.**
 
• **The Golden House** is a 2017 novel **by Salman Rushdie**.
